title: White-Box Countermeasures Against Higher-Degree Algebraic Attacks
summary: The BU-model and quadratic masking were proposed to protect white-box implementations from linear algebraic attacks, but higher-degree countermeasures remain unresolved.

formal_statement.body: For white-box implementations, the BU-model and a quadratic masking scheme had been proposed to protect against linear algebraic attacks, while countermeasures against higher-degree attacks remained unresolved. The open problem is to develop or identify countermeasures that protect white-box implementations against higher-degree algebraic attacks.

scope.domain: Protection of white-box implementations against algebraic cryptanalysis.
parameters: Attack degree: distinguishes linear algebraic attacks from higher-degree algebraic attacks
scope.unresolved_remainder: Develop or identify countermeasures that protect white-box implementations against higher-degree algebraic attacks.

citations.label: Dummy Shuffling against Algebraic Attacks in White-box Implementations

progress.summary: The source presents the BU-model and quadratic masking as protection against linear algebraic attacks, then explicitly states that countermeasures against higher-degree attacks were left open.
